sahoo_2016_analogy: Facies 1 of Sahoo et al. (2016). Multi-storey channel-belt sandstone.
Facies 2 of Sahoo et al. (2016). Planar and parallel laminated sandstone sheets.
Facies 3 of Sahoo et al. (2016). Interbedded rippled sandstone and siltstone.
Facies 4 of Sahoo et al. (2016). Organic-rich mudstone associated with mire margins.
Facies 5 of Sahoo et al. (2016). Autochthonous mire peat / coal seam. Forms chronostratigraphic markers.
Facies 6 of Sahoo et al. (2016). Overbank floodplain mudstone; may include minor abandoned channel-plug muds.
